title: Canada, round two: three chapters rebuilt on what she replays (a plan)
kaylee: She washes and paints a muddy bear, plays flashlight statues with a raccoon, and gets an otter's lucky rock back from the whales. All three get built: pick the one that goes first.

pitches.title: Misty's Bubble Bath (replaces Salmon Leap)
pitches.finger: Rub the muddy bear: suds, rain, fluff, then berry colors.
pitches.learns: A spirit bear is a black bear with white fur. She uncovers it herself.
pitches.silly: Tap Misty's nose and she sneezes suds over everything.
pitches.why: It's the barber, with a whole bear. Misty keeps the look for the big game.

pitches.title: Campfire Night in 3D: Flashlight Statues
pitches.finger: Her finger is the flashlight. Whoever it lands on freezes.
pitches.learns: Night animals' eyes shine. Turn the light off and the stars come out.
pitches.silly: Caught sneaking, Roxy freezes: "I'm a tree."
pitches.why: The Koh Samet laugh: a build-up, then a silly face in close-up.

pitches.title: Whale Peek-a-Boo (Whale Watch with a reason)
pitches.finger: Touch the bubbles and a whale comes up. Then play with it.
pitches.learns: Whales breathe out of their heads. Sea otters keep a favorite rock.
pitches.silly: Every spout soaks Maple, with a new crazy face each time.
pitches.why: Today she steers to a whale and watches. Now the whale is the toy, and Ollie needs her rock back.

pictures.title: The Team Cabin (optional, after the three)
pictures.caption: Her wardrobe, for the team. She dresses each friend who has joined, and they wear it on the map and in the big game.

questions: The Team Cabin (dress the team, like her wardrobe): build it after the three chapters? Yes or no.
Misty keeps the look from her bath, so a pink bear may take the slap shot in the big game. Good?
Mountain Bike and Red Canoe are steering games, like the ones she skips. Leave them until her play diary says so, or rethink them next?
